# hpe_morpheus_network_server (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_server" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_server" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network server (integration)
- `name` (String) The name of the network server (integration)

### Read-Only

- `admin_port` (Number)
- `api_port` (Number)
- `config` (Dynamic) Network server configuration object. Settings vary by integration type.
- `description` (String) Description
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `external_id` (String) External ID
- `internal_id` (String) Internal ID
- `network_filter` (String) Network Filter
- `service_host` (String) Service Host
- `service_mode` (String) Service Mode
- `service_password` (String, Sensitive) The service password for the network server integration
- `service_path` (String) Service Path
- `service_port` (Number) Service Port
- `service_token` (String, Sensitive) The service token for the network server integration
- `service_url` (String) Service URL
- `service_username` (String) Service Username
- `tenant_match` (String) Tenant Match
- `visibility` (String)
- `visible` (Boolean)
- `zone_id` (Number) Cloud ID
